content.comment_body: Hello, is there a way to renew the device certificate for the [product_name] PLC? Mine expired on May 1st, 2024 and I am unable to access the webserver since the secure HTTPS connection can no longer be used. The root certificate is valid until 2070, so that's not the problem. I didn't find anything in the manual or within [product_name] software menus. Any advice would be greatly appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]
Which model of [product_name] are you using exactly? For instance, is it [version_no] or [version_no]?
With both [version_no] devices, I am able to connect to their extended web server without any problems.
I'm using a [version_no] model. I've uploaded a screenshot to illustrate the issue. I hope this helps clarify things. Regards, [user_name]
I'm unfamiliar with that view. Is that the certificate you're seeing in your browser? For me, it appears differently in the [product_name] software.
That screenshot was from my browser. However, I see something else in [product_name] software. It seems I'm missing something.
Yes, your screenshot does look different from mine. If I were in your situation, I'd consider submitting a support request.

Looking back, setting up HTTPS for a PLC—especially a logic module—feels somewhat unnecessary. Typically, controllers aren't connected straight to the Internet; you'd use a router and firewall in between. There are various reverse proxies like nginx that enable secure (encrypted) connections to a device on your local network.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering an issue with expired device certificates on a [product_name] PLC, which blocks access to secure web services via HTTPS. The lack of guidance in the software and documentation leads to user frustration and confusion, especially regarding how to manage or renew the certificate. The interface does not clearly indicate certificate status, and there is no straightforward solution or support process visible to users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, step-by-step instructions and a simple interface for renewing or updating device certificates on [product_name] PLCs. They also want transparent documentation within the software or manual to help resolve certificate-related issues.
